text: {"lessons":["Routine month-to-month swings have not justified frequent trading; I should keep turnover low unless fundamentals, valuation, or portfolio risk meaningfully change.","Selling Stock E at a substantial loss was uncomfortable, but my cost basis is sunk; future decisions should depend on expected return and risk, not a desire to avoid realizing a loss.","One sale and a modest account rebound do not establish that the timing was right; I should assess decisions by their rationale and long-term portfolio fit, not short-term outcomes."]}
